text:
Marin (Product): thinking out loud: customers ask for temporary SLO relaxations during migrations. idea: add a 'temporary SLO' panel in console that can simulate changes, attach to ticket, and optionally apply for a short TTL. what are the tradeoffs?
Owen (Eng): two big axes: 1) evaluation model (merge at eval vs materialize), 2) visibility (how telemetry/alerts show up). merge-at-eval keeps rule model clean but adds lookup overhead
Callie (Eng-Platform): agree. merge-at-eval design we used for feature flags would work: cache overlays per-tenant+rule for 60s, apply on eval. we should persist overlays in the overlays-service and emit overlay metadata with each alert
Priya (SRE): must emphasize routing. If applied, should default to NOT escalate to customer on-call. CS-level notification only unless explicitly escalated. otherwise ops gets paged unexpectedly
Marin (Product): default CS-only makes sense. also want an 'estimate impact' button in the panel that runs a cheap simulation so CS can see "expected alerts per day" delta
Owen (Eng): cheap simulation approach: sample last 24h windows at 1% and compute hit delta. surface both raw count and normalized per-100k-requests metric. mark it as "sampled_estimate":true
Callie (Eng-Platform): API sketch for creating overlay (proto):
POST /api/v1/overlays
{
  "overlay_id":"ov-456",
  "base_rule":"rule-987",
  "tenant_id":"t-34",
  "new_threshold": 0.98,
  "expires_in_seconds": 86400,
  "notify_scope": "cs-only",
  "reason": "data-migration, reduce noisy alerts",
  "preview_sample_rate": 0.01
}
Priya (SRE): include an `audit_actor` and `ticket_ref` so we can tie overlays to support tickets and show in the audit timeline
Owen (Eng): telemetry-wise: add tag `overlay.origin=ui` and `overlay.id=ov-456`. also increment metric `alerts.overlay_applied{tenant}` so we can graph overlays impact over time
Marin (Product): UX note: preview should show uncertainty bounds (+/-) and a small warning about canary tenants
Callie (Eng-Platform): good point — overlays should not apply to canaries by default. add optional field `applies_to: [{type: "tenant", "id": "t-34"}]` and `exclude_canaries:true`
Priya (SRE): ops checklist: create dashboard for overlays, a burn-rate style alert on `alerts.overlay_applied` trips, and an automated job to expire overlays and notify CS when expired
Owen (Eng): scale note: we should cap overlays per-tenant (e.g., 3 active), and enforce a global overlay evaluation budget to avoid thundering lookups during heavy eval windows
Marin (Product): rollout plan: feature-flag both UI and API, pilot with internal beta tenants, run preview-only for 10 days, then allow apply with CS-only notify for 30 days before enabling customer escalation
Callie (Eng-Platform): dev tasks: overlay storage schema, eval-time merge hook, cache layer, telemetry tagging; I'll open proto PR and include sample preview response shape by EOD
deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch `slo-temp-panel-ux` — build 9012. logs: https://ci.redwood.local/builds/9012 :rocket:
Priya (SRE): final ask: ensure overlays are visible in the SLO history view (so we can correlate incidents with overlays). also include a flag for 'emergency manual revoke'
Marin (Product): thanks folks. I'll draft the RFC with acceptance criteria (preview accuracy, default notify scope, TTL defaults). follow-ups: Owen adds metrics hooks, Callie prototypes API, Priya drafts ops runbook.
